import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().processInput();
    }

    private void processInput() {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = in.readInt();
        String line = in.readLine() + "_";

        boolean insideParentheses = false;
        boolean insideWord = false;
        int wordCountInsideParens = 0;
        int currentWordLength = 0;
        int longestWordLength = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index <= n; index++) {
            char currentChar = line.charAt(index);

            if (insideWord) {
                if (isBoundary(currentChar)) {
                    insideWord = false;
                    if (insideParentheses) {
                        wordCountInsideParens++;
                    } else {
                        if (currentWordLength > longestWordLength) {
                            longestWordLength = currentWordLength;
                        }
                    }
                    if (currentChar == '(') insideParentheses = true;
                    if (currentChar == ')') insideParentheses = false;
                    currentWordLength = 0;
                } else {
                    currentWordLength++;
                }
            } else {
                if (!isBoundary(currentChar)) {
                    insideWord = true;
                    currentWordLength = 1;
                } else {
                    if (currentChar == '(') insideParentheses = true;
                    if (currentChar == ')') insideParentheses = false;
                }
            }
        }

        pw.printf("%d %d%n", longestWordLength, wordCountInsideParens);
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    private boolean isBoundary(char c) {
        return c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')';
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream));
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String readLine() {
            try {
                return reader.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }

        public int readInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        private String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }
    }
}
